candidates.title: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters (Tsinghua, PKU, SJTU, Galbot)
candidates.reason: Weighted 74.75. < 80. In window. Verified on arXiv abstract and project page: 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone with a trainable action DiT, compared against 2B-552B backbones; 10-demo LIBERO-Goal 87.8% vs 85.6% for a 2B backbone with 50 demos, LIBERO-PRO 45.1% vs at most 31.3%, real charger insertion 9/10 vs 4/10, 216 ms median latency. Gains are modest on simulation, the real-robot test is 10 trials, and no code or weights are linked from the paper or project page, so reproducibility is low.
